protocol.aggregation: Each independent case has equal1/20 weight; no pooling with the400-case midgame suite.

execution_environment.platform: Actual machine recorded at runtime: M4/M1/WSL/Intel
execution_environment.note: Common2.2.2 CPU comparison. WSL4logical/2physical affinity20-23. macOS actual controls differ and are recorded. Existing unrelated applications remain running.

protocol.warm_condition: resident production worker; imports/load and fixed synchronized warmup separately recorded outside trial timers
protocol.order_rule: repeat outer; random paired-case permutation; within odd-size strata alternate extra first-method allocation; exactly10 SAT-first and10 auto-first pairs per repeat
primary_metrics: independent-case mean capped cost: valid within-budget success wall seconds, otherwise60
secondary_metrics: observed model stages and SAT fallback
setup cost and actual wall time
protocol.inference: stratified paired independent-case cluster bootstrap; preserve all3 repeats and both methods. N20 is a supplementary fixed-case test, not a guarantee of5percent precision.

precision_targets.note: Reporting targets only; N20 does not guarantee these. Boundary-degenerate bootstrap intervals never establish precision.

selection.selection_seed_rule: 730271+stratum_index; sample sorted-by-seed eligible cases without replacement using CPython random.Random.sample
selection.exclusion_rule: Before random selection exclude any seed present in short main/pilot accepted or rejected generation, and any board present in short main/pilot accepted cases. If a candidate-pool board repeats, retain its first seed before sampling. No outcome or timing data are used.
selection.source: unmeasured independently seeded legal random-game terminal cases
selection.duplicates_policy: 20 distinct seeds/games and distinct boards, disjoint from midgame accepted boards and attempted seeds

protocol.pass_label: Reference contains pass does not prove every reconstruction needs a pass.
protocol.completion: Complete predeclared120 trials; no timing-based resampling, no successful-case-only headline, no pooling with midgame study.

sat_concurrency.policy: Benchmark-only shared flock slots0/1; wrapper parent retains lock while real Kissat runs in the existing process group. Version queries bypass locks.
sat_concurrency.timing: Python wrapper startup and queued-slot waiting are included; never subtracted. Native source/portfolio/search policy are unchanged, but real simultaneous SAT jobs are capped2, unlike production3/6.

protocol.compatibility_note: PyTorch2.2.2 with NumPy1.26.4 and CPython3.12 provides CPU wheels across macOS ARM, macOS Intel and Linux x86_64. Package versions are enforced by the common runner. CPU hardware, operating system and native numerical backend remain different and are recorded.
protocol.environment_controls: CPU/FP32,2 Torch/OMP/BLAS threads,nice19. WSL affinity20-23; macOS does not provide matching strict affinity. Actual affinity/load/resource conditions are logged. Native SAT portfolio/search policy and Kissat4.0.3 remain identical; benchmark-only wrapper caps simultaneously active real solvers at2 and its startup/wait are measured.
protocol.prior_cpu26_note: Completed WSL2.6 configuration is retained separately as production-reference data and is not pooled with the four-environment2.2.2 comparison.

provenance.source_candidate_pool: 80 independently seeded cases per terminal stratum from the private prepared long bank; no solver results existed for selection
